title: The native condensed-module pullback preserves the braiding
statement: For any commutative condensed ring Λ, scheme morphism f:X→Y and internal Λ_Y-modules M,N, use the ordinary pullback of [def-sfb-module-upper-star] and its native composite monoidal_upperStar structure built from mapMod and extension along the coefficient-pullback isomorphism. Then f*(β(M,N));δ(N,M)=δ(M,N);β(f*M,f*N), where δ is this native oplax tensorator and β is the relative-module braiding for the tensor product of [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor] with symmetry [def-sfb-modobj-symmetric-tensor]. No flatness, properness or coefficient quotient hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Paragraphs (1), (3): the ordinary symmetric tensor-pullback normalization; Stacks 03EL. Explicit balanced-coequalizer proof extracted from the proved ordinary braiding helpers of lean/Sheaf/Paper/TraceBaseChangeFirst.lean.

proof.text: For a braided ambient functor F, precompose the two sides of the mapMod lax braided equation with Mod.tensorObjπ. The tensorator equation tensorπ_mapModTensorIso_hom_hom, the braiding equation tensorObjπ_braidingHomX, and F.LaxBraided.braided identify them. The coequalizer map is epi and the forgetful functor is faithful, so cancel to prove the module equation.

For comap along an isomorphism ψ, use tensorπ_comapTensorIso_hom_hom and tensorObjπ_braidingHomX to prove the analogous braided equation after precomposing with the epi relative tensor projection. Transport it along extendScalarsIsoComapInv to extension along ψ inverse, using the specified transported monoidal structure.

Apply the two calculations to the actual abelian-sheaf inverse image and coefficient-pullback isomorphism, and compose their lax braided structures. This is the native monoidal_upperStar tensorator. Precompose the desired oplax equation with its invertible lax tensorator, apply the lax braided identity and both μ;δ=identity equations, and cancel.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeUpperStar_braiding
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y)) :
    letI := monoidal_upperStar Λ f
    (upperStar Λ f).map (β_ M N).hom ≫ Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (upperStar Λ f) N M =
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (upperStar Λ f) M N ≫
        (β_ ((upperStar Λ f).obj M) ((upperStar Λ f).obj N)).hom
